source: SP 20.13330.2016 8.2.4: beams and slabs of the uses of items 1, 2 and 12 a with a loaded area A > A1 = 9 m² take ψA1 = 0.4 + 0.6 / √(A / A1) = 0.4 + 1.8 / √A; 8.2.5: columns, walls and foundations of n floors ψn1 = 0.4 + (ψA1 - 0.4) / √n, which is the same formula on the n floors' area (KLL = 1); the halls of ψA2 (items 4, 11, 12 b, c) are not reduced (P).
